import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # bar row: find the row that's all same nonzero color (2)
    bar=max(range(h), key=lambda i: len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=0)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out[bar]=g[bar][:]
    cells=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if i!=bar and g[i][j]!=0]
    # group into connected same-color objects (adjacent)
    import collections
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    cellsd={(i,j):v for i,j,v in cells}
    for c in cells:
        if c[:2] in seen: continue
        stack=[c[:2]]; comp=[]
        while stack:
            p=stack.pop()
            if p in seen: continue
            seen.add(p); comp.append((p[0],p[1],cellsd[p]))
            for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                q=(p[0]+di,p[1]+dj)
                if q in cellsd and q not in seen: stack.append(q)
        objs.append(comp)
    for comp in objs:
        bot=max(i for i,j,v in comp)
        drop=bar-1-bot
        for i,j,v in comp:
            out[i+drop][j]=v
    return out
